Name: Wizard to Witch CP Version of CreepyKat
Author: lineyakitty
Description:
***1.2 Version was broken updated to fix the content file! Also if you have the mod make sure you replace the config file with the new one!

This mod was inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1011]Female Wizard[/url]﻿ mod by CreepyKat. I included the files from their mod in content patcher form. I was also inspired by Novatius's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1031]mod[/url] for the idea behind this one.

I made changes to several Data files and String files via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ to change the Wizard's name from Rasmodius to Rasmodia, reference her as a witch, change her to female in the game files, and change the teleport sprite in cursors.

There is also a config option to change the witch ex-wife to a warlock ex-husband. This will change the Witch Hut in the game to the Warlock Hut.

It is very easy to see where i made the changes in the content file. Feel free to adjust as necessary to suit your self!

Also thanks to LavenderLight's DIYCP series for helping me navigate the Content Patcher format. I'm a newbie at this.

Please let me know if you have any issues with this mod or if you notice a reference to the wizard that I missed!

Updated to fix Lewis's dialogue at the Spirit's Eve event, thanks to DrakeWyrm's comment.

Updated to include custom warlock sprite as well as support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2948]Ran's Prettier Witch[/url]﻿. Simply pull the image file out, rename it Cursors_Witch and add it to the folder before setting the config Pretty Witch to yes! Alternatively just add in Ran's mod and leave both my config options as No.
